metaDescription: Order custom white badge ID holders for your team. Durable vinyl pouches in bulk. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: White badge ID holders offer a clean, professional look that suits corporate offices, healthcare facilities, and event staff. Unlike clear holders that can show wear, white vinyl pouches provide a crisp background that makes printed IDs or access cards stand out. Choose from styles with hang holes, bulldog clips, or pin backs to match your security needs. Perfect for bulk orders where consistency and brand presentation matter.
